The original rendered pages were visually inspected before clipping. Only figure regions are included, without surrounding prose or page headers.

Figure 2.7 does not state a full analytic formula for its decaying curve. The demo explicitly uses 2 exp(−(t+2)) u(t+2) as an analytic realization, not an equation quoted from the book. Other examples use their textbook formulas exactly.

pp. 178–180: motivation, t versus τ, graphical process, repeated output points. p. 181: Example 2.10. p. 183: Example 2.11. pp. 185–187: Example 2.12 and width. pp. 187–188: drills and Figures 2.11–2.13. pp. 189–190: intuitive explanation and Figure 2.14 (part of §2.4-2, not a different section).

No generative image service used; no missing-asset placeholders.

- At t=0 in Example 2.11, what is c(0)?
